parts.covers: Closing book packs for the two milks on 2026-06-28, to compare with the hand count before trusting their value.

parts.covers: Checks the premise that ordered_units was 0 on 10-12 June and shows the forecast inputs (28-day mean of recorded sales, book stock, on-order, reorder point, order-up-to); no table records why the ordering logic produced 0, and book stock is
parts.sql: select substr("forecasts-june"."date",1,10) as "date", "forecasts-june"."method" as "method", "forecasts-june"."forecast_units_per_day" as "forecast_units_per_day", "forecasts-june"."book_on_hand" as "book_on_hand", "forecasts-june"."on_order" as "on_order", "forecasts-june"."reorder_point" as "reorder_point", "forecasts-june"."order_up_to" as "order_up_to", "forecasts-june"."ordered_units" as "ordered_units" from "forecasts-june"  where ("forecasts-june"."sku" = ?) and (substr(substr("forecasts-june"."date",1,10),1,10) between ? and ?) order by "date" asc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From forecast row records; keep rows where forecasts.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' and day(forecasts.date) between 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-12; report date = day(forecasts.date), method = forecasts.method, forecast_units_per_day = forecasts.forecast_units_per_day, book_on_hand = forecasts.book_on_hand, on_order = forecasts.on_order, reorder_point = forecasts.reorder_point, order_up_to = forecasts.order_up_to, ordered_units = forecasts.ordered_units; sorted by date asc.

parts.covers: Checks the empty-shelf premise against the 11:00 audits on 10-12 June; audits are twice-weekly snapshots, so an empty shelf on a day with no audit is not recorded (shelf_hours).
parts.sql: select "shelf-audits-june"."audit_ts" as "audit_ts", "shelf-audits-june"."status" as "status" from "shelf-audits-june"  where ("shelf-audits-june"."sku" = ?) and (substr(substr("shelf-audits-june"."audit_ts",1,10),1,10) between ? and ?) order by "audit_ts" asc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From shelf-audit row records; keep rows where shelf audits.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' and day(shelf audits.audit_ts) between 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-12; report audit_ts = shelf audits.audit_ts, status = shelf audits.status; sorted by audit_ts asc.

parts.covers: Recorded sales feeding the 28-day mean forecast up to 12 June; sales are not demand, and lost sales while the shelf was empty are not recorded (Rule 3), so the forecast can only be read against sales, not true demand.
parts.sql: select substr("daily-sales-june"."date",1,10) as "date", sum("daily-sales-june"."units_sold") as "units_sold" from "daily-sales-june"  where ("daily-sales-june"."sku" = ?) and (substr(substr("daily-sales-june"."date",1,10),1,10) between ? and ?) group by substr("daily-sales-june"."date",1,10) order by "date" asc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From daily sales row records; keep rows where daily sales.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' and day(daily sales.date) between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-12; group by day(daily sales.date); report date = day(daily sales.date), units_sold = sum of daily sales.units_sold; sorted by date asc.

parts.covers: Ranks SKUs by summed stock-count adjustments in June 2026 as a partial recorded shrink stand-in; theft and other causes are not recorded, so the highest shrink does not establish the most theft.
parts.sql: select "stock-counts-june"."sku" as "sku", sum("stock-counts-june"."adjustment") as "count_adjustment_packs" from "stock-counts-june"  where (substr(substr("stock-counts-june"."count_ts",1,10),1,10) between ? and ?) group by "stock-counts-june"."sku" order by "count_adjustment_packs" asc limit 1
parts.plan_in_words: From stock count records; keep rows where day(stock counts.count_ts) between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-28; group by stock counts.sku; report sku = stock counts.sku, count_adjustment_packs = sum of stock counts.adjustment; sorted by count_adjustment_packs asc.

parts.covers: Shows June write-offs by SKU and recorded reason (damaged or expired) as additional shrink evidence; no write-off reason identifies theft.
parts.sql: select "write-offs-june"."sku" as "sku", "write-offs-june"."reason" as "reason", sum("write-offs-june"."units") as "written_off_units" from "write-offs-june"  where (substr("write-offs-june"."date",1,10) between ? and ?) group by "write-offs-june"."sku", "write-offs-june"."reason" order by "written_off_units" desc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From write-off records; keep rows where write offs.date between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-28; group by write offs.sku, write offs.reason; report sku = write offs.sku, reason = write offs.reason, written_off_units = sum of write offs.units; sorted by written_off_units desc.

parts.covers: Adds the recorded DC stock corrections for 2026-06-23 to 2026-06-25 by SKU and reason; these warehouse corrections are not store theft evidence and no table records theft or its causes.
parts.sql: select "dc-stock-adjustments-june"."sku" as "sku", "dc-stock-adjustments-june"."reason" as "reason", sum("dc-stock-adjustments-june"."units") as "adjusted_units", sum("dc-stock-adjustments-june"."value_at_cost_inr") as "adjustment_value_at_cost_inr" from "dc-stock-adjustments-june"  where (substr(substr("dc-stock-adjustments-june"."adjusted_ts",1,10),1,10) between ? and ?) group by "dc-stock-adjustments-june"."sku", "dc-stock-adjustments-june"."reason" order by "adjustment_value_at_cost_inr" asc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From warehouse (DC) stock adjustment records; keep rows where day(dc stock adjustments.adjusted_ts) between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-28; group by dc stock adjustments.sku, dc stock adjustments.reason; report sku = dc stock adjustments.sku, reason = dc stock adjustments.reason, adjusted_units = sum of dc stock adjustments.units, adjustment_value_at_cost_inr = sum of dc stock adjustments.value_at_cost_inr; sorted by adjustment_value_at_cost_inr asc.

parts.covers: Checks the stated +157 adjustment on 26 June against the recorded count; no table records why the adjustment was made (cause not recorded).
parts.sql: select "stock-counts-june"."count_ts" as "count_ts", "stock-counts-june"."sku" as "sku", "stock-counts-june"."book_before" as "book_before", "stock-counts-june"."counted" as "counted", "stock-counts-june"."adjustment" as "adjustment", "stock-counts-june"."trigger" as "trigger" from "stock-counts-june"  where ("stock-counts-june"."sku" = ?) and (substr(substr("stock-counts-june"."count_ts",1,10),1,10) = ?) limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From stock count records; keep rows where stock counts.sku = 'ATTA-WW-1KG' and day(stock counts.count_ts) = '2026-06-26'; report count_ts = stock counts.count_ts, sku = stock counts.sku, book_before = stock counts.book_before, counted = stock counts.counted, adjustment = stock counts.adjustment, trigger = stock counts.trigger.

parts.covers: Shows the warehouse's own recorded corrections for this item (covers 23-25 June only); the stated 160-pack mis-pick is a premise to check, and no record states a cause linking it to the store count.
parts.sql: select "dc-stock-adjustments-june"."adjusted_ts" as "adjusted_ts", "dc-stock-adjustments-june"."slot" as "slot", "dc-stock-adjustments-june"."cases" as "cases", "dc-stock-adjustments-june"."units" as "units", "dc-stock-adjustments-june"."reason" as "reason" from "dc-stock-adjustments-june"  where ("dc-stock-adjustments-june"."sku" = ?) limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From warehouse (DC) stock adjustment records; keep rows where dc stock adjustments.sku = 'ATTA-WW-1KG'; report adjusted_ts = dc stock adjustments.adjusted_ts, slot = dc stock adjustments.slot, cases = dc stock adjustments.cases, units = dc stock adjustments.units, reason = dc stock adjustments.reason.

parts.covers: Recorded pick shortfall in cases for this item before the count, as evidence bearing on the mis-pick premise; packs-per-case conversion and any causal link to the +157 are not recorded.
parts.sql: select count(*) as "pick_lines", sum("dc-pick-confirmations-june"."cases_ordered") as "cases_ordered", sum("dc-pick-confirmations-june"."cases_confirmed") as "cases_confirmed", (sum("dc-pick-confirmations-june"."cases_ordered") - sum("dc-pick-confirmations-june"."cases_confirmed")) as "case_shortfall" from "dc-pick-confirmations-june"  where ("dc-pick-confirmations-june"."sku" = ?) and (substr(substr("dc-pick-confirmations-june"."pick_ts",1,10),1,10) between ? and ?) limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From pick confirmation records; keep rows where dc pick confirmations.sku = 'ATTA-WW-1KG' and day(dc pick confirmations.pick_ts) between 2026-06-20 and 2026-06-26; report pick_lines = count of *, cases_ordered = sum of dc pick confirmations.cases_ordered, cases_confirmed = sum of dc pick confirmations.cases_confirmed, case_shortfall = sum of dc pick confirmations.cases_ordered - sum of dc pick confirmations.cases_confirmed.

parts.covers: Checks the premise by listing every June 2026 negative closing book-stock row for MILK-FC-500ML; book stock is a calculated belief, not observed shelf stock, and no table records why it became negative.
parts.sql: select substr("inventory-book-june"."date",1,10) as "date", "inventory-book-june"."book_on_hand_close" as "negative_closing_stock_packs" from "inventory-book-june"  where ("inventory-book-june"."sku" = ?) and ("inventory-book-june"."book_on_hand_close" < ?) order by "date" asc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From book-stock row records; keep rows where inventory book.sku = 'MILK-FC-500ML' and inventory book.book_on_hand_close < 0; report date = day(inventory book.date), negative_closing_stock_packs = inventory book.book_on_hand_close; sorted by date asc.

parts.covers: Shows recorded sales on the negative-book-stock dates as evidence of what the tills recorded, not proof that Store 014 sold physical milk it lacked; actual shelf availability, unrecorded sales and the cause of the discrepancy are not record
parts.sql: select substr("daily-sales-june"."date",1,10) as "date", "daily-sales-june"."units_sold" as "recorded_units_sold", "daily-sales-june"."revenue_inr" as "recorded_revenue_inr", "inventory-book-june"."book_on_hand_close" as "book_closing_stock_packs" from "daily-sales-june" inner join "inventory-book-june" on "daily-sales-june"."sku" = "inventory-book-june"."sku" and substr("daily-sales-june"."date",1,10) = substr("inventory-book-june"."date",1,10) where ("daily-sales-june"."sku" = ?) and ("inventory-book-june"."book_on_hand_close" < ?) order by "date" asc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From daily sales row records; inner-join book-stock row records on daily sales.sku = inventory book.sku and day(daily sales.date) = day(inventory book.date); keep rows where daily sales.sku = 'MILK-FC-500ML' and inventory book.book_on_hand_close < 0; report date = day(daily sales.date), recorded_units_sold = daily sales.units_sold, recorded_revenue_inr = daily sales.revenue_inr, book_closing_stock_packs = inventory book.book_on_hand_close; sorted by date asc.

parts.covers: Provides June hand counts and corrections for MILK-FC-500ML as observations that can contradict the inventory book; the records do not identify which receipt, sale, write-off or other event caused any mismatch.
parts.sql: select "stock-counts-june"."count_ts" as "count_time", "stock-counts-june"."book_before" as "book_before_packs", "stock-counts-june"."counted" as "physically_counted_packs", "stock-counts-june"."adjustment" as "adjustment_packs", "stock-counts-june"."trigger" as "count_trigger" from "stock-counts-june"  where ("stock-counts-june"."sku" = ?) order by "count_time" asc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From stock count records; keep rows where stock counts.sku = 'MILK-FC-500ML'; report count_time = stock counts.count_ts, book_before_packs = stock counts.book_before, physically_counted_packs = stock counts.counted, adjustment_packs = stock counts.adjustment, count_trigger = stock counts.trigger; sorted by count_time asc.

parts.covers: Lists the June 11:00 shelf-audit snapshots for MILK-FC-500ML as limited physical-availability evidence; they are twice-weekly snapshots, so continuous shelf stock, restocking times and whether a particular sale lacked milk are not recorded.
parts.sql: select "shelf-audits-june"."audit_ts" as "audit_time", "shelf-audits-june"."status" as "shelf_status" from "shelf-audits-june"  where ("shelf-audits-june"."sku" = ?) order by "audit_time" asc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From shelf-audit row records; keep rows where shelf audits.sku = 'MILK-FC-500ML'; report audit_time = shelf audits.audit_ts, shelf_status = shelf audits.status; sorted by audit_time asc.

parts.sql: select count(*) as "pick_lines", sum((abs(("dc-pick-confirmations-june"."cases_confirmed" - "dc-pick-confirmations-june"."cases_ordered")) * 1.0 / nullif(abs(("dc-pick-confirmations-june"."cases_confirmed" - "dc-pick-confirmations-june"."cases_ordered")), 0))) as "in_full_pick_lines" from "dc-pick-confirmations-june"  limit 200

parts.covers: Per-delivery OTIF inputs for June arrivals: on time is arrived_ts between slot_start and slot_end, and in full requires every pick line to have cases_confirmed = cases_ordered; the code must compute the OTIF share and compare it with 92%, 9
parts.sql: select "shipments-june"."shipment_id" as "shipment_id", "shipments-june"."arrived_ts" as "on_time", "shipments-june"."slot_start" as "slot_start", "shipments-june"."slot_end" as "slot_end", count("dc-pick-confirmations-june"."line") as "pick_lines", sum(("dc-pick-confirmations-june"."cases_ordered" - "dc-pick-confirmations-june"."cases_confirmed")) as "short_lines" from "shipments-june" left join "dc-pick-confirmations-june" on "shipments-june"."shipment_id" = "dc-pick-confirmations-june"."shipment_id" where (substr(substr("shipments-june"."arrived_ts",1,10),1,10) between ? and ?) group by "shipments-june"."shipment_id", "shipments-june"."arrived_ts", "shipments-june"."slot_start", "shipments-june"."slot_end" order by "shipment_id" asc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From shipment records; left-join pick confirmation records on shipments.shipment_id = dc pick confirmations.shipment_id; keep rows where day(shipments.arrived_ts) between 2026-06-01 and 2026-06-28; group by shipments.shipment_id, shipments.arrived_ts, shipments.slot_start, shipments.slot_end; report shipment_id = shipments.shipment_id, on_time = shipments.arrived_ts, slot_start = shipments.slot_start, slot_end = shipments.slot_end, pick_lines = count of dc pick confirmations.line, short_lines = sum of dc pick confirmations.cases_ordered - dc pick confirmations.cases_confirmed; sorted by shipment_id asc.
